name: Dampers
oneLineScope: Louver, butterfly and guillotine duct dampers for gas and air service, rectangular ducts up to 4,000 × 3,000 mm

specTable.value: Class II · Class IV per AMCA 500

types.name: Louver (multi-blade)
types.description: Multiple parallel blades for modulating flow control; suited to large rectangular ducts.

types.name: Butterfly (single-blade)
types.description: Single rotating blade for on/off or throttling duty in circular ducts.

types.name: Guillotine (slide-gate)
types.description: Flat plate slides across the duct opening for tight shut-off; suited to particulate-laden or high-temperature gas.

types.name: Isolation damper
types.description: Heavy-duty multi-blade with inflatable seal for positive gas-tight isolation.

faqs.question: What types of dampers do you manufacture?
faqs.answer: Precise Engineers manufactures louver (multi-blade), butterfly (single-blade), guillotine (slide-gate) and isolation dampers for gas and air ducting in power, cement, steel and process plant service.

faqs.question: What duct sizes can be accommodated?
faqs.answer: Duct size data are pending confirmation from engineering. Dampers are designed to fit existing circular and rectangular duct cross-sections and are supplied with a matching flanged frame for installation.

faqs.question: What actuation options are available?
faqs.answer: Manual (lever or handwheel), electric, pneumatic or hydraulic actuation. The actuator is sized to the damper torque or thrust requirement at operating conditions. Fail-safe spring-return actuators are available for safety-critical applications.

faqs.question: What is the difference between a louver damper and a guillotine damper?
faqs.answer: A louver damper uses multiple parallel blades and is preferred for modulating flow control in large rectangular ducts. A guillotine damper uses a single flat plate that slides across the full duct opening, providing positive shut-off in high-temperature or particulate-laden gas where blade dampers may seize or accumulate dust.

faqs.question: What leakage class and temperature range do your dampers achieve?
faqs.answer: Leakage class and temperature range are application-specific, depending on blade material, seal design and actuation. Precise Engineers is ISO 9001:2015 certified and EIL approved. Contact us with your duct size, gas temperature and isolation duty for a detailed specification.
